invariants.rationale: Returning null would violate the typical contract that collection-returning APIs should return an empty collection instead of null.

meta.value: The method returns a new ArrayList<WriteStatus> populated by JavaLazyInsertIterable. Even if no records are written, an (empty) non-null list is returned.

invariants.rationale: Result is assigned from the writeStatuses ArrayList and always a List.

meta.value: The return type of the method is List<WriteStatus> and result is always constructed as an ArrayList.

invariants.rationale: Ensures the returned list has a valid, non-negative size.
Prevents downstream NPE; WriteStatus list elements should not be null.

meta.value: Each WriteStatus is added from JavaLazyInsertIterable::addAll, which should not introduce nulls by contract.
